title: VOCE Human Cognitive Assurance
status: VOCE public human-factors assurance framework; non-diagnostic and not a clinical instrument
purpose: Evaluate how agentic and digital systems shape attention, cognitive load, memory, verification, decision quality, fatigue and human oversight.
principles: Human oversight is effective only when the human can understand, notice and act in time.
Cognitive friction can be protective when it creates a meaningful verification step.
Automation should not silently remove the cues humans use to detect anomalies or uncertainty.
Cognitive controls are evaluated at the workflow and interface level, not used to diagnose individuals.
Evidence should distinguish laboratory findings, field observations, institutional inference and VOCE editorial synthesis.
Material changes to models, interfaces, alerts, permissions or task allocation can change cognitive risk and trigger reassessment.

domains.name: Attention & interruption
domains.description: Interruptions, switching, alerting and the ability to sustain or recover task focus.

domains.name: Cognitive load & complexity
domains.description: Information density, working-memory demand, multi-step execution and interface complexity.

domains.name: Verification & over-trust
domains.description: Checks, friction, confidence calibration and the risk of accepting fluent machine output without meaningful review.

domains.name: Memory & cognitive offloading
domains.description: What users must remember, what systems externalise, and whether critical knowledge remains retrievable and understood.

domains.name: Decision quality & uncertainty
domains.description: Uncertainty, missing information, anomaly detection and the conditions under which judgment is exercised.

domains.name: Fatigue & temporal load
domains.description: Decision fatigue, sustained monitoring, recovery, circadian constraints and workload timing.

domains.name: Human oversight & skill retention
domains.description: Whether humans retain comprehension, intervention capability and enough practice to take over when automation fails.

i18n.it: Supervisione umana e mantenimento delle competenze

domains.name: Social & relational signals
domains.description: Loss or distortion of interpersonal cues in mediated, automated or compressed communication.

controls.title: Interruption recovery
controls.question: Does the workflow measure how quickly and accurately a user can resume a material task after an interruption or agent escalation?

fr.title: Reprise après interruption
fr.question: Le workflow mesure-t-il la rapidité et la précision avec lesquelles un utilisateur reprend une tâche importante après une interruption ou une escalade de l’agent?

it.title: Ripresa dopo un’interruzione
it.question: Il workflow misura rapidità e precisione con cui un utente riprende un compito rilevante dopo un’interruzione o un’escalation dell’agente?

controls.title: Alert saturation
controls.question: Are alerts prioritised and rate-limited so that critical signals remain perceptible rather than competing with routine notifications?

fr.title: Saturation des alertes
fr.question: Les alertes sont-elles hiérarchisées et limitées afin que les signaux critiques restent perceptibles au lieu d’entrer en concurrence avec les notifications ordinaires?

it.title: Saturazione degli avvisi
it.question: Gli avvisi sono prioritizzati e limitati affinché i segnali critici restino percepibili invece di competere con notifiche ordinarie?

controls.title: Attentional handoff
controls.question: When an agent transfers control to a human, does the interface restore the minimum context needed to understand what happened and what requires attention?

fr.title: Passage de relais attentionnel
fr.question: Lorsqu’un agent rend la main à un humain, l’interface restitue-t-elle le contexte minimal nécessaire pour comprendre ce qui s’est passé et ce qui exige son attention?

it.title: Passaggio di consegne attentivo
it.question: Quando un agente trasferisce il controllo a una persona, l’interfaccia ripristina il contesto minimo necessario per capire cosa è accaduto e cosa richiede attenzione?

controls.title: Working-memory demand
controls.question: Has the institution measured how many independent facts, states or pending actions the user must hold in mind at the same time?

fr.title: Charge de mémoire de travail
fr.question: L’institution a-t-elle mesuré combien de faits, d’états ou d’actions en attente l’utilisateur doit maintenir simultanément en mémoire?

it.title: Carico sulla memoria di lavoro
it.question: L’istituzione ha misurato quanti fatti, stati o azioni in sospeso l’utente deve mantenere contemporaneamente in memoria?

controls.title: Context-switch burden
controls.question: Does the workflow minimise unnecessary movement between tools, agents, windows and representational formats during one decision?

fr.title: Coût des changements de contexte
fr.question: Le workflow réduit-il les passages inutiles entre outils, agents, fenêtres et formats de représentation au cours d’une même décision?

it.title: Costo dei cambi di contesto
it.question: Il workflow riduce i passaggi non necessari tra strumenti, agenti, finestre e formati di rappresentazione durante una stessa decisione?

controls.title: Information-density threshold
controls.question: Can a user identify the material facts, uncertainty and required action without parsing non-essential model output?

fr.title: Seuil de densité informationnelle
fr.question: L’utilisateur peut-il identifier les faits matériels, l’incertitude et l’action requise sans devoir parcourir des sorties de modèle non essentielles?

it.title: Soglia di densità informativa
it.question: L’utente può identificare fatti rilevanti, incertezza e azione richiesta senza dover analizzare output del modello non essenziali?

controls.title: Cognitive checksum
controls.question: Does every high-consequence action preserve a meaningful verification step rather than removing all friction in the name of speed?

fr.title: Checksum cognitif
fr.question: Toute action à forte conséquence conserve-t-elle une vérification significative au lieu de supprimer toute friction au nom de la vitesse?

it.title: Checksum cognitivo
it.question: Ogni azione ad alto impatto conserva una verifica significativa invece di eliminare ogni attrito in nome della velocità?

controls.title: Confidence calibration
controls.question: Does the interface help users distinguish well-supported output from uncertain, incomplete or weakly grounded output?

fr.title: Calibration de la confiance
fr.question: L’interface aide-t-elle à distinguer une sortie solidement étayée d’une sortie incertaine, incomplète ou faiblement ancrée?

it.title: Calibrazione della fiducia
it.question: L’interfaccia aiuta a distinguere un output ben supportato da uno incerto, incompleto o scarsamente fondato?

controls.title: Automation-confirmation bias
controls.question: Has the system been tested for the tendency of users to approve a plausible machine recommendation without independently checking material evidence?

fr.title: Biais de confirmation de l’automatisation
fr.question: Le système a-t-il été testé pour détecter la tendance à approuver une recommandation machine plausible sans vérifier indépendamment les preuves importantes?

it.title: Bias di conferma dell’automazione
it.question: Il sistema è stato testato per rilevare la tendenza ad approvare una raccomandazione plausibile della macchina senza verificare in modo indipendente le evidenze rilevanti?

controls.title: Source-memory preservation
controls.question: Can users distinguish what they knew, what the system retrieved and what the model generated when revisiting a decision?

fr.title: Préservation de la mémoire des sources
fr.question: Lorsqu’une décision est revue, l’utilisateur peut-il distinguer ce qu’il savait, ce que le système a retrouvé et ce que le modèle a généré?

it.title: Preservazione della memoria delle fonti
it.question: Quando una decisione viene riesaminata, l’utente può distinguere ciò che sapeva, ciò che il sistema ha recuperato e ciò che il modello ha generato?

controls.title: Critical knowledge retention
controls.question: Does automation preserve enough human practice that essential procedural knowledge is still available when the system is unavailable?

fr.title: Rétention des connaissances critiques
fr.question: L’automatisation préserve-t-elle suffisamment de pratique humaine pour que les connaissances procédurales essentielles restent disponibles lorsque le système est indisponible?

it.title: Conservazione delle conoscenze critiche
it.question: L’automazione preserva una pratica umana sufficiente affinché le conoscenze procedurali essenziali restino disponibili quando il sistema non lo è?

controls.title: Memory expiry awareness
controls.question: Are users told when an agent's memory is partial, expired, reset or inconsistent with the current institutional record?

fr.title: Visibilité de l’expiration de la mémoire
fr.question: Les utilisateurs sont-ils informés lorsque la mémoire d’un agent est partielle, expirée, réinitialisée ou incohérente avec le registre institutionnel actuel?

it.title: Visibilità della scadenza della memoria
it.question: Gli utenti vengono informati quando la memoria di un agente è parziale, scaduta, reimpostata o incoerente con il registro istituzionale corrente?

controls.title: Missing-information visibility
controls.question: Does the system explicitly expose material information that is missing instead of presenting an incomplete situation as complete?

fr.title: Visibilité de l’information manquante
fr.question: Le système expose-t-il explicitement les informations matérielles absentes au lieu de présenter une situation incomplète comme complète?

it.title: Visibilità delle informazioni mancanti
it.question: Il sistema espone esplicitamente le informazioni rilevanti mancanti invece di presentare come completa una situazione incompleta?

controls.title: Weak-signal preservation
controls.question: Does digitisation preserve the contextual or interpersonal signals required to detect anomalies, manipulation or unusual cases?

fr.title: Préservation des signaux faibles
fr.question: La numérisation préserve-t-elle les signaux contextuels ou interpersonnels nécessaires pour détecter anomalies, manipulations ou cas inhabituels?

it.title: Preservazione dei segnali deboli
it.question: La digitalizzazione preserva i segnali contestuali o interpersonali necessari a rilevare anomalie, manipolazioni o casi insoliti?

controls.title: Decision latency fit
controls.question: Is the time allowed for human judgment proportionate to consequence, novelty and uncertainty rather than determined only by system speed?

fr.title: Adéquation du temps de décision
fr.question: Le temps laissé au jugement humain est-il proportionné aux conséquences, à la nouveauté et à l’incertitude plutôt qu’à la seule vitesse du système?

it.title: Adeguatezza del tempo decisionale
it.question: Il tempo concesso al giudizio umano è proporzionato a conseguenze, novità e incertezza invece di essere determinato soltanto dalla velocità del sistema?

controls.title: Sustained-monitoring burden
controls.question: Has the organisation tested how vigilance changes when humans supervise long periods of mostly correct automated execution?

fr.title: Charge de surveillance prolongée
fr.question: L’organisation a-t-elle testé l’évolution de la vigilance lorsque des humains supervisent longtemps une exécution automatisée généralement correcte?

it.title: Carico di monitoraggio prolungato
it.question: L’organizzazione ha testato come cambia la vigilanza quando le persone supervisionano a lungo un’esecuzione automatizzata per lo più corretta?

controls.title: Decision-fatigue exposure
controls.question: Are repeated approval tasks batched, prioritised or redesigned so human oversight does not become a high-volume confirmation queue?

fr.title: Exposition à la fatigue décisionnelle
fr.question: Les validations répétitives sont-elles regroupées, hiérarchisées ou repensées afin que la supervision humaine ne devienne pas une file de confirmations à haut volume?

it.title: Esposizione all’affaticamento decisionale
it.question: Le approvazioni ripetitive sono aggregate, prioritizzate o riprogettate affinché la supervisione umana non diventi una coda di conferme ad alto volume?

controls.title: Circadian and recovery fit
controls.question: For continuous operations, are high-consequence review duties scheduled with recovery and circadian constraints in mind?

fr.title: Compatibilité circadienne et récupération
fr.question: Dans les opérations continues, les tâches de revue à forte conséquence tiennent-elles compte de la récupération et des contraintes circadiennes?

it.title: Compatibilità circadiana e recupero
it.question: Nelle operazioni continue, le attività di revisione ad alto impatto tengono conto del recupero e dei vincoli circadiani?

controls.title: Takeover comprehension
controls.question: Can a human asked to intervene explain the agent's current state, objective, recent actions and remaining uncertainty before acting?

fr.title: Compréhension lors de la reprise en main
fr.question: Un humain appelé à intervenir peut-il expliquer l’état actuel de l’agent, son objectif, ses actions récentes et l’incertitude restante avant d’agir?

it.title: Comprensione nella ripresa del controllo
it.question: Una persona chiamata a intervenire può spiegare lo stato attuale dell’agente, il suo obiettivo, le azioni recenti e l’incertezza residua prima di agire?

controls.title: Skill-atrophy control
controls.question: Does the operating model preserve deliberate human practice for skills that become essential when automation fails or is withdrawn?

fr.title: Contrôle de l’atrophie des compétences
fr.question: Le modèle opérationnel préserve-t-il une pratique humaine volontaire des compétences qui redeviennent essentielles lorsque l’automatisation échoue ou disparaît?

it.title: Controllo dell’atrofia delle competenze
it.question: Il modello operativo preserva una pratica umana deliberata delle competenze che tornano essenziali quando l’automazione fallisce o viene rimossa?

controls.title: Meaningful override
controls.question: Is the human override understandable, timely and operationally effective rather than a nominal button available after consequences are irreversible?

fr.title: Override réellement utile
fr.question: La reprise de contrôle humaine est-elle compréhensible, suffisamment précoce et opérationnellement efficace plutôt qu’un bouton nominal disponible après l’irréversibilité des conséquences?

it.title: Override realmente efficace
it.question: La ripresa del controllo umano è comprensibile, tempestiva ed effettivamente operativa invece di essere un pulsante nominale disponibile quando le conseguenze sono già irreversibili?

controls.title: Social-cue loss
controls.question: Where judgment depends on interpersonal context, has the institution identified which non-verbal or contextual cues are lost through mediated or agentic interaction?

fr.title: Perte des signaux sociaux
fr.question: Lorsque le jugement dépend du contexte interpersonnel, l’institution a-t-elle identifié les signaux non verbaux ou contextuels perdus dans l’interaction médiatisée ou agentique?

it.title: Perdita dei segnali sociali
it.question: Quando il giudizio dipende dal contesto interpersonale, l’istituzione ha identificato i segnali non verbali o contestuali persi nell’interazione mediata o agentica?

controls.title: Synthetic-interaction disclosure
controls.question: Can a person reliably tell when they are interacting with an automated agent and understand the limits of that interaction?

fr.title: Divulgation de l’interaction synthétique
fr.question: Une personne peut-elle identifier de manière fiable qu’elle interagit avec un agent automatisé et comprendre les limites de cette interaction?

it.title: Trasparenza dell’interazione sintetica
it.question: Una persona può riconoscere in modo affidabile che sta interagendo con un agente automatizzato e comprenderne i limiti?

controls.title: Relational escalation
controls.question: Do sensitive or emotionally consequential interactions have criteria for transfer from automation to a qualified human?

fr.title: Escalade relationnelle
fr.question: Les interactions sensibles ou émotionnellement conséquentes disposent-elles de critères de transfert de l’automatisation vers un humain qualifié?

it.title: Escalation relazionale
it.question: Le interazioni sensibili o con conseguenze emotive dispongono di criteri per trasferire il caso dall’automazione a una persona qualificata?

review_triggers: Change in alerting or escalation logic
Change in staffing, shifts or supervision model
Observed rise in errors, overrides, fatigue or missed alerts
Introduction of synthetic social interaction in a sensitive context
clinical_boundary: The framework evaluates systems and workflows. It does not diagnose, screen, treat or profile an individual's mental health, cognitive disorder or neuropsychological condition.
